svg.text: Only essays whose Learners chose you. There is no shared queue; you do not see the
essay past 48 hours, grade it soon
An essay joins the queue when a Learner chooses you. The deadline is 48 hours after that; when late, the Learner is told and may move it to
another Examiner (at most twice), and it leaves your queue.
You take at most 5 new essays a day, Writing and Speaking together; at 5, Learners
cannot choose you until the day ends.
